Egy lassú oldal látogatót és pénzt veszí: A slow site loses visitors and money, and Google ranks it lower too. Let's look at what slows most sites down, and what you can do about it.
A weboldal sebessége nem technikai aprós: Website speed isn't a technical detail — it hits revenue directly. People click away from a slow site before it loads, and Google ranks it lower as well. Let's look at why, and what you can do.
<strong>Felhasználó:</strong> a látogató: The visitor: a significant share of visitors leave if the page doesn't load within a few seconds. Every extra second costs conversions.
<strong>Google:</strong> a kereső a felh: Google: the search engine also watches user experience (Core Web Vitals — loading, interactivity, visual stability) as a ranking factor. A slow site starts at a disadvantage.
<strong>Túl nagy képek:</strong> a legya: Oversized images: the most common culprit. An unprocessed, multi-megabyte photo drags out loading for no reason.
<strong>Sok és nehéz script:</strong> mi: Too many heavy scripts: every plugin, embedded widget and tracking tag slows things down. Here, less really is more.
<strong>Lassú vagy túlterhelt tárhely:</: Slow or overloaded hosting: a cheap, crowded server will hold back even the best code.
<strong>Nincs gyorsítótár (cache):</stro: No caching: if the page is rebuilt from scratch for every visitor, it's doing unnecessary work.
<strong>Renderelést blokkoló erőforrások: Render-blocking resources: CSS or JS that stops the page from displaying until it has loaded.
Ingyenes, megbízható eszköz a Google <st: Google's PageSpeed Insights (pagespeed.web.dev) is a free, reliable tool — enter the URL and you get a score for mobile and desktop plus specific recommendations. Always look at mobile first: that's where most visitors come from.
<strong>Optimalizáld a képeket:</strong>: Optimise your images: the right size, a modern format (WebP, say), compression. This alone makes a big difference.
<strong>Késleltetett betöltés (lazy load: Lazy loading: images further down the page should only load when the visitor scrolls to them.
<strong>Kevesebb plugin/script:</strong>: Fewer plugins and scripts: delete what you don't use. Every embed is paid for in speed.
<strong>Cache és CDN:</strong> a gyorsít: Caching and a CDN: a cache and a content delivery network bring the site closer to the visitor.
<strong>Jó tárhely:</strong> ha mindent: Decent hosting: if you've optimised everything and it's still slow, the server is the bottleneck.
A sebesség pénz: gyorsabb oldal = több m: Speed is money: a faster site means more visitors who stay, better Google rankings and more enquiries. Start with the images and the unnecessary scripts — on most sites those two account for the bulk of the improvement. If you'd rather build from the ground up: this is how we build websites.
